matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: Fast R-CNN trains roughly nine times faster than R-CNN and reaches higher mean average precision on PASCAL VOC.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: Fast R-CNN achieves a higher mAP on PASCAL VOC 2012 compared to R-CNN.

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: Fast R-CNN trains the entire network in a single stage using a multi-task loss that jointly optimizes classification and bounding-box regression.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: Fast R-CNN uses a single-stage training algorithm that jointly learns to classify object proposals and refine their spatial locations.
